verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government industrial-property office: patents, trademarks, designs, filings, renewals and fees. It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and consume external tools, so asking whether MCP servers can be plugged into it is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply, and the llms.txt probe concerns agent-facing docs, not client-side MCP support.
